description: Defines the ClientCollateralManagement entity class, representing collateral management details for clients, including quantity, associated client, collateral info, and related loan collateral management.

classes.name: ClientCollateralManagement
classes.description: Entity class for managing client collateral data, including quantity, client, collateral info, and related loan management set.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new ClientCollateralManagement instance from a JsonCommand, extracting the 'quantity' parameter.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance with specified quantity, client, and collateral.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity based on a JsonCommand if there is a change, and returns the changes as a map.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates total value of collateral as quantity multiplied by collateral's base price.

methods.name: getTotalCollateral
methods.description: Calculates total collateral value based on a provided total and collateral percentage to base.

methods.name: updateQuantityAfterLoanClosed
methods.description: Adjusts the quantity after a loan is closed by adding the specified amount.
